verdict.rationale: Luma's own materials describe Luma Agents built into its browser-based creative workspace. Users can hand them multi-step video and image workflows, and the agents research, generate, and refine across media. Luma Skills lets a delegated workflow be saved and rerun. Missing for 10: in-depth first-party docs on how delegation works in the UI (task scoping, review, limits), and independent or hands-on corroboration of the in-product agent.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
